title: Orientation
description: auto picks from the page box: a column (target over the bias) for upright boxes, a strip (target beside the bias) for wide ones.

title: Alignment
description: Where the target sits in the box. Strip: left (also center) puts the target first, right mirrors the strip for a page on the right of the screen.

title: Dot lifetime
description: How many recent hits stay on the target as dots. The newest 40 are drawn bright; older ones fade. All hits keeps the whole attempt as a dim cloud that brightens where hits cluster. The bias arrow and the spread ellipse always cover the whole attempt.

title: Spread ellipse
description: Outline how widely the attempt's hits scatter around their average (one standard deviation, tilted along the cloud).

title: Keep on results
description: Hold the finished attempt's scatter on the results screen, which shows no cursor accuracy in osu!stable or lazer. Off: show during gameplay only.

title: Motion
description: full = each hit lands as an amber ring, the bias arrow and ellipse ease to the new average, the box eases in and out. reduced = values and enter/exit still ease; no landing ring. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps the target and its readout visible on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = the target on the game with its own soft lens; only for a dimmed background.

title: Map colour
description: Draw the map's hit circle (its circle size) in the colour taken from the map's background. Off = neutral. Your newest hit stays 18-LAB amber either way.
